title: [Nov 18 - Dec 18] New AI Game Jam is Live: $100K in Cash Prizes (sponsored by ElevenLabs, fal.ai and Meshy)
author: yerbamate2020
selftext:
Hey everyone! Posted about our upcoming game jam a while ago on this sub and it is officially live 🥳

**Key links**:  
\- Jam site: [opengame.io/jam](http://opengame.io/jam)   
\- Discord: [https://discord.gg/9uUjSAQe2W](https://discord.gg/9uUjSAQe2W) 

Take a (short) break from GTA VI and come jam :)

**Key info:**  
\- We have an incredible panel of 20+ judges from the tech, AI and gaming communities.  
\- ElevenLabs, fal, and Meshy are kind enough to be sponsoring the event and giving out free starter credits to participants. They are also giving out lots of credits to dedicated track-winners for "Best use of \[their tool\]". Sponsor prizes are separate from the $100k cash prize pool (which is funded by our platform).  
\- You can use whatever tools you typically use to build and any major game engine that exports to the web, including ThreeJS, Unity, Unreal 5.9, Godot, Kaigen, and more  
\- Browser games only targeting desktops (mouse/keyboard) with optional controller support. No mobile gameplay. Custom and proprietary engines are also permitted, provided the final game runs in a desktop web browser. Native desktop executables, Steam downloads, mobile games, touchscreen-only games, and games requiring specialized hardware aren't eligible.  
\- This is beginner-friendly. Anyone can now create incredible, immersive games and experiences. Humans are the artists; models are just paintbrushes!  
\- Games must be created during the jam. Pre-existing games or projects already in development are not eligible. Reusable assets, libraries, tools, and general-purpose frameworks are permitted, but pre-existing game-specific gameplay, levels, and substantial completed game systems are not.  
\- We're looking for thoughtfully crafted games, not one-shot generations. We believe gaming is the ultimate form of art. Submissions must be complete, playable experiences rather than unfinished prototypes or technical demos. A complete game can be short or simple, but should deliver a cohesive, polished gameplay experience with a clear objective or replayable gameplay loop. Participants can submit up to 2 games; we value depth, creativity, and polish over quantity!  
\- 18+ years old, individuals only (no teams). Open worldwide except where prohibited by law or applicable sanctions. Winners must complete required identity, eligibility, and tax checks before receiving prizes. Prizes are subject to applicable taxes and withholding. See official rules at [opengame.io/jam](http://opengame.io/jam) for details.  
\- To ensure fairness, we operate on an honor system supported by community reporting and verification of potential winners. We reserve the right to request development history, source code, or other evidence that a game was created during the jam, and to disqualify submissions that violate these rules.  
\- The jam will be hosted on [opengame.io](http://opengame.io). All submissions must be uploaded to and playable directly on the platform.  
\- There is no required theme, but each game must fall into one of the 10 genres below.

**Exact prize pool is as follows**  
**(i) Best Game Overall**: $50,000 prize pool: 1st place receives $25,000, 2nd place $17,500, and 3rd place $7,500. All games are automatically considered, regardless of genre.  
**(i) Top 3 in Each Genre**: $50,000 total prize pool: Each of the 10 genres has a $5,000 prize pool ($2,500 for 1st, $1,500 for 2nd, and $1,000 for 3rd). Genres include Shooter & Survival, Action & Adventure, RPG, Platformer, Strategy, Simulation & Management, Racing & Sports, Fighting, Puzzle & Casual, and Party, Social & Sandbox.

*\*Prizes displayed are gross amounts. Payouts are net of any tax we are required by law to withhold. Each participant selects one primary genre for their game. We reserve the right to reclassify submissions that do not reasonably fit their selected genre. Each game can win only one cash prize, but may also win sponsor-specific credit prizes. Games awarded Best Game Overall cannot also receive a genre-specific cash prize.*
